pr_title: Bluetooth: Controller: Fix ticker slot reserved check
pr_body:
Fix ticker slot reserved check to handle deferred execution of ticker worker where ticks_elapsed is greater than ticks_slot_previous. In which case, each ticker expiring be checked for overlap with previous slot reservation.

This fixes:
ASSERTION FAIL [0] @ WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/subsys/bluetooth/ controller/ll_sw/nordic/lll/lll.c:476
lll_preempt_calc: Actual EVENT_OVERHEAD_START_US = 3906

Flash erase operation exposed the assertion, CPU being halted deferred the ticker_worker collision resolution and ticker expiry was not individually checked for overlap with previous expired ticker reservation.

Fixes #51600.

Fix missing first connection event due to first connection
event ticks_slot of central and peripheral overlapping with
the initiator window ticks_slot and advertising ticks_slot,
respectively.

Use ticker_stop_abs interface so that when the ticker is
stopped the ticks_slot_previous is truncated to the actual
ticks used as requested by the supplied absolute ticks.

Relates to commit https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/commit/8a294a62d4843fb5ecbca5e193b44a970e5bf3d1 ("Bluetooth: controller: legacy: Fix missing first conn event").

Signed-off-by: Vinayak Kariappa Chettimada <vich@nordicsemi.no>

issue_context.title: Bluetooth assert on flash erase using mcumgr
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
A bluetooth assert is hit when mcumgr is used to erase the flash for an image upload.

**To Reproduce**
Ensure slot sizes are large, I used a slot size of 0x70000, then build `zephyr/samples/subsys/mgmt/mcumgr/smp_svr` for a target board:
1. `mkdir build`
2. `cmake -GNinja -DBOARD=<BOARD> -DAPP_DIR=.. -DSB_CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT=y -Dsmp_svr_OVERLAY_CONFIG="overlay-bt.conf" ../../../../../../share/sysbuild/`
3. `ninja`
4. `west flash`
5. Once device is flashed, use mcumgr to upload an application: `mcumgr --conntype ble --connstring ctlr_name=hci0,peer_name='Zephyr' image upload zephyr/zephyr.signed.bin` if this starts uploading right away with no error, hit reboot on the board and try again (erase will only run if there is data in the flash)
6. Board will assert with:
```
ASSERTION FAIL [0] @ WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/subsys/bluetooth/controller/ll_sw/nordic/lll/lll.c:476 lll_preempt_calc: Actual EVENT_OVERHEAD_START_US = 3906
E: r0/a1:  0x00000003  r1/a2:  0x20004ee8  r2/a3:  0x00000001
E: r3/a4:  0x0003153d r12/ip:  0x00000000 r14/lr:  0x000191eb
E:  xpsr:  0x41000028
E: Faulting instruction address (r15/pc): 0x000191f6
E: >>> ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 3: Kernel oops on CPU 0
E: Fault during interrupt handling
E: Current thread: 0x20001448 (mcumgr smp)
E: Halting system
```

**Expected behavior**
No assert

**Impact**
Showstopper

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Linux
 - Commit SHA or Version used: b8a957a0ebd955ed65b7f1e64c74dac794a37fb3
comments:
The assertion was added in commit https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/commit/ebf723626704aaffa95a2a22fb4415a4ae59bf00 to detect ISR latencies due to user application implementation and/or any regression in Controller subsystem implementation.

Apparently, co-operation between flash driver and Zephyr Controller exposes possible bug in scheduling non-overlapping flash and Bluetooth radio use.

Prior to adding the assertion check, Bluetooth events were gracefully skipped on delays.  Which is acceptable until this is not continuous leading to connection timeout.

I will investigate, if there any inherent design limitation that could be causing the delays.
@nordicjm could you just double-check this is fixed in `main`?

review_comments: I would prefer to move the expression up and set `slot_reserved` for clarity.

In the current implementation if `slot_reserved` is true, then rest of the expression is not evaluated. If I move the expression up then `instance->ticks_slot_previous > ticks_expired` will be evaluated irrespective of `slot_reserved` being true.
